entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-02
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • One line of code causes an IDE exception #78802
  • `switch` keyword not recommended after invocation expression #78800
    Backlog
  • Remove unused usings is getting cancelled for no reason #78799
  • Code Analysis Failing With Exceptions thrown #78797
  • Assertion failed when running "Remove unnecessary imports" #78795
  • VB compilation crashes when made of 2 syntax trees with top-level statements #78792
  • Recent Solution Explorer Progression changes appear to have broken VS tests #78791

Closed

  • Delete the workaround for CodeLens tests failing #77995
  • ReduceExtensionMethod throw NullReferenceException when specifying `ref struct` symbol as receiverType #78430
    Next
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10701.20 #78789
  • Crash in `RemoveUnnecessarySuppressions` caused by multi-variable declaration #78786

Created

  • Merge vscode release 2.80.14 into release/vscode #78801
    Needs API Review, VSCode

    Area-Infrastructure
  • Second attempt at updating versions #78796
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Implement the editor's new 'speculative edit' api to allow copilot suggestions to be classified accurately with Roslyn. #78794
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Keep parse options in the result of `SyntaxFactory.Parse*` methods #78790

  • Directly create virtual project when dotnet run-api is missing for now #78788

  • Ensure sln load uses project absolute paths #78772

  • Remove workarounds for bugs that have been fixed #78779
    Area-IDE, Next

    Area-IDE, Next

    Area-Analyzers, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Avoid dereferencing null CheckConstraintsArgs.CurrentCompilation #78729
    Area-Compilers, Next

    Area-IDE, VSCode

  • EnC: Simplify diagnostic reporting #78708
